research.scope: The 2025 FAST paper informed the attention to delta-maintenance costs. The older Windows API article documents the existing thread scheduling mode. Current source and measurements determine the new reference selection.

validation.qualification_note: The initial sanitizer job was below a previous measured peak. The rerun sized its allowed share using live headroom, the prior peak and the retained host reserve. The complete suite used the original sanitizer configuration.
validation.benchmark_loader_note: The relocated parent executable also needed its verified WinFsp user-mode SDK DLL. The bounded launcher logged the failure, with the inherited Windows error-mode flags, and the copied test passed after direct import inspection and staging.

method.order: Three cyclic rotations per cohort. Each rotation used the same 15 files and checked every file after reopening the compacted image on CPU.
method.inputs: The prior controlled reference-pricing workloads use synthetic bytes or public-file samples. Both deliberately conceal changes from the eight-tile sampler.
method.size: Complete protected indexed compacted image including mirrored payloads and metadata.
method.time: Wall-clock sum of route discovery, maintenance and independent compacted-image verification. Fixture creation is outside the interval. Idle opportunities are modeled.
method.cpu_sampled: The controller from source base a9c28db uses eight-tile pricing.
method.cpu_full: The current ordinary maintenance path compares five references per complete group, one extent pair per granted opportunity. Each of five groups contains twenty peers per reference.
method.amd_full: The current controller uses the authenticated ABI 10 worker and kernel from a9c28db. Each of the five groups evaluates two references under the admitted device and launch grant.
method.limits: This compares complete routes with their admitted search depths. Runtime behavior on naturally related files, random-read amplification, interference under actual foreground work, and mounted throughput remain to be measured.
